newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE nearby white sugar deepens losses by close.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE nearby white sugar deepens losses by close.

text.p: Nearby white sugar prices in London extended losses by the close on Wednesday after raw prices in New York slumped.
May white sugar finished $2.10 easier at its low for the day of $304.70 per tonne.

May raws prices in New York drifted further below the 11.00 cents/lb level and hedge selling against the European Union's weekly tender for sugar export licences also pressured the London white sugar market lower.
August closed the day $1.30 softer at its low of $403.90.
Volume was 1,535 lots, of which 1,129 were in May.
In Paris, May closed down $1.10 at $305.60 and August off 40 cents at $304.10.
